# hackbuild suite

> Browser AI and 3D character tools that run in one tab, built on the hackbuild libraries. Each example does one job in one TypeScript file: it exports `mount(host)`, draws a hackbuild-ui layout, and binds a view package to a library. Model weights load in the browser through a model pick; the examples ship stub loaders so they run with nothing downloaded, and `weightsLoader(store)` from @hackbuild/ai-views loads real weights.

Live site: https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/. Every example is at https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/<job>/<id>, with its source on screen.

## Libraries

- [hackbuild-browser-ai](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-browser-ai/llms.txt): chat, speech, vision, image and the model catalogue in the browser
- [hackbuild-motion](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-motion/llms.txt): avatars, retargeting, ik, gait and lip sync on three.js
- [hackbuild-agents](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/llms.txt): drives, senses, cameras and movers for agents in a scene
- [hackbuild-ui](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-ui/llms.txt): the design system: tokens, classes, layouts and the model picker

## Explorers

- [yard](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/yard/Yard.vue): the dog simulator, in this tab. source `src/explorers/yard/Yard.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/yard
- [chat](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/chat/ChatStudio.vue): talk to a model in this tab. source `src/explorers/chat/ChatStudio.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/chat
- [character](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/character/CharacterExplorer.vue): a body that talks, looks and listens. source `src/explorers/character/CharacterExplorer.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/character
- [room](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/room/RoomExplorer.vue): an agent living in a room, and its mind. source `src/explorers/room/RoomExplorer.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/room
- [transcribe](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/transcribe/Transcribe.vue): recordings to text you can edit. source `src/explorers/transcribe/Transcribe.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/transcribe
- [mask studio](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/masks/MaskStudio.vue): cut things out, by hand or by model. source `src/explorers/masks/MaskStudio.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/masks
- [find](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/vision/VisionLab.vue): what is in a picture or a camera. source `src/explorers/vision/VisionLab.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/vision
- [make an image](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/generate/Generate.vue): a prompt becomes a picture. source `src/explorers/generate/Generate.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/generate
- [relief](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/src/explorers/relief/Relief.vue): a photo to a relief you can print. source `src/explorers/relief/Relief.vue`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/x/relief

## Examples: talk

- [chat with a small model](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/talk/chat/example.ts): a reply streams from a model in this tab. source `examples/talk/chat/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/chat @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/talk/chat
- [a reply with its thinking folded](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/talk/think/example.ts): reasoning streams into a fold, the answer under it. source `examples/talk/think/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/chat @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/talk/think
- [answer as json to a schema](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/talk/json/example.ts): a model fills a schema, checked before you see it. source `examples/talk/json/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/chat @hackbuild/structured @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/talk/json
- [remember facts across chats](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/talk/memory/example.ts): what it recalls for each reply, and why. source `examples/talk/memory/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/chat @hackbuild/memory @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/talk/memory
- [a character card in and out](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/talk/character-card/example.ts): read a card, edit it, write it back. source `examples/talk/character-card/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/chat @hackbuild/character @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/talk/character-card

## Examples: listen

- [transcribe a file](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/listen/transcribe/example.ts): drop a recording, get lines with their times. source `examples/listen/transcribe/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/listen/transcribe
- [push to talk dictation](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/listen/dictate/example.ts): hold to talk, let go to get the words. source `examples/listen/dictate/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @hackbuild/listen @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/listen/dictate
- [speak a line](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/listen/speak/example.ts): text to speech with the words timed. source `examples/listen/speak/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @hackbuild/speak @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/listen/speak
- [speak with lip sync](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/listen/lipsync/example.ts): a body says a line and its mouth follows. source `examples/listen/lipsync/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @hackbuild/motion-views @hackbuild/speak @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/listen/lipsync

## Examples: see

- [find objects on the webcam](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/see/detect/example.ts): boxes and labels drawn on the frame. source `examples/see/detect/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/see/detect
- [cut out a subject with a click](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/see/cut-out/example.ts): press a thing, get its mask. source `examples/see/cut-out/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/see/cut-out
- [depth from a photo](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/see/depth/example.ts): a photo becomes a surface you can turn. source `examples/see/depth/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @hackbuild/depth-mesh @hackbuild/motion-views @hackbuild/vision three @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/see/depth
- [ask about a picture](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/see/ask/example.ts): a question about an image, answered in words. source `examples/see/ask/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/ai-env @hackbuild/ai-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/see/ask

## Examples: move

- [load a vrm, glb or fbx and pose it](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/move/avatar/example.ts): drop a character and it stands, looks and waves. source `examples/move/avatar/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/motion-views @hackbuild/avatar @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/move/avatar
- [retarget a clip](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/move/retarget/example.ts): a clip made for one body plays on another. source `examples/move/retarget/example.ts`, install `npm install three @hackbuild/retarget @hackbuild/motion-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/move/retarget
- [reach with two bone ik](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/move/ik/example.ts): drag the target, the arm follows. source `examples/move/ik/example.ts`, install `npm install three @hackbuild/ik @hackbuild/motion-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/move/ik
- [a dog that walks](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/move/gait/example.ts): four legs, a gait and a speed. source `examples/move/gait/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/gait three @hackbuild/motion-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/move/gait

## Examples: think

- [a creature with drives](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/think/drives/example.ts): needs rise, a choice is made, the bars show why. source `examples/think/drives/example.ts`, install `npm install @hackbuild/drives @hackbuild/agents-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/think/drives
- [a camera that follows](https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-suite/blob/main/examples/think/cameras/example.ts): five rigs on one moving target. source `examples/think/cameras/example.ts`, install `npm install three @hackbuild/cameras @hackbuild/agents-views @hackbuild/motion-views @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui`, live https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-suite/#/examples/think/cameras
